english.title: NewsBridge Successfully Connects to Neon Database
english.summary_30: Backend ingestion pipeline operational with Postgres.
english.summary_111: NewsBridge backend migrated to Neon serverless Postgres. RSS pipeline collects from 5 German sources with seamless deduplication.
english.summary_250: NewsBridge integrated with Neon Postgres. Backend ingestion fully operational, collecting from Tagesschau, Der Spiegel, Deutsche Welle, Handelsblatt. Processed 95 articles, detected 94 duplicates. All operations working flawlessly.
